scope: All fetched branch/tag history; all unique reachable blobs, including deleted files; ASCII/UTF-16 strings extracted from binary blobs; ZIP/Office/3MF members inspected separately

findings.details: Wi-Fi strings are SDK placeholder values. Gitleaks flags the default OpenThread example master key in commit 1c754581594f234628edc89b7cd4e84766bed459, sdkconfig:1898 and sdkconfig.old:1897. No confirmed live project credential.

Private keys and example credentials in upstream crypto/network tests and demos. Some matches are PEM marker strings or cryptographic constants rather than credentials. Preserve upstream license files; do not treat test keys as trusted credentials.
Footprint cache descriptions and base64-encoded model bytes match generic secret/token patterns.
Non-GitHub emails, local usernames/paths, document/CAD creators, pilot identifiers and GPS routes. Publication/identity policy requires author review; values intentionally omitted from this report.

limitations: Pattern-based scanning is not proof that every secret or personal detail has been found.
No live credential verification or external token validation was attempted.
Binary files were searched for printable strings; proprietary binary metadata and encrypted data may need tool-specific review.
Historical phone/address-like content in documents or photographs may require manual review.
Unreachable server-side refs, forks and remote caches are outside this local audit.

tools.supplemental: all-blob string scan, source/sdkconfig assignment scan, archive member scan, author/committer metadata review
